name: @raskell/wasm-ad
description: AssemblyScript SDK for writing WASM-AD carts

scripts.build: asc examples/starter.ts --config asconfig.json -o build/starter.wasm && node ../../tools/wasmad.mjs meta build/starter.wasm title=Starter author=raskell.io "description=The WASM-AD starter cart, in AssemblyScript"
scripts.prepack: mkdir -p bin && cp ../../tools/wasmad.mjs bin/wasmad.mjs && cp ../../LICENSE LICENSE
